005package org.wpilib.vision.apriltag;
006
007import org.wpilib.util.RawFrame;
008import org.wpilib.vision.apriltag.jni.AprilTagJNI;
009
010/** AprilTag image generation utilities. */
011public final class AprilTagImageGenerator {
012  private AprilTagImageGenerator() {
013    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This is a utility class!");
014  }
015
016  /**
017   * Generates a RawFrame containing the AprilTag with the id from family 16h5.
018   *
019   * @param id ID
020   * @return A RawFrame containing the AprilTag image
021   */
022  public static RawFrame generate16h5AprilTagImage(int id) {
023    RawFrame frame = new RawFrame();
024    AprilTagJNI.generate16h5AprilTagImage(frame, frame.getNativeObj(), id);
025    return frame;
026  }
027
028  /**
029   * Generates a RawFrame containing the AprilTag with the id from family 36h11.
030   *
031   * @param id ID
032   * @return A RawFrame containing the AprilTag image
033   */
034  public static RawFrame generate36h11AprilTagImage(int id) {
035    RawFrame frame = new RawFrame();
036    AprilTagJNI.generate36h11AprilTagImage(frame, frame.getNativeObj(), id);
037    return frame;
038  }
039}
